lessons.trigger_condition: V397 can own and roll back one canonical declarative extension, but it relies on a single upstream candidate and does not explicitly synthesize several safe operational alternatives, compare them with verified local outcome memory, quarantine repeatedly failing recipes, or prevent overlapping V397/V398 experiments.
lessons.prevention_rule: V398 must preserve V397/V391/V390 and all prior hard gates, synthesize only canonical V373 declarative candidates from operational freshness, coverage, source health, neural consensus, drift, uncertainty, resource and upstream verified evidence, rank them deterministically with V390 goal alignment plus local verified KPI outcome memory, apply at most one V398-owned next-cycle canary, quarantine materially regressing recipes, roll back only the exact V398-owned capability, defer when a V397 experiment is present, and keep source-level functionality on the non-executable verified-canary to protected-PR/CI path.
validation_required: watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v398.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v398.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v398 while preserving v397, v391, v390 and prior controllers
candidate synthesis uses canonical V373 primitives only and operational evidence only
candidate tournament is deterministic and combines current evidence, V390 goal alignment, bounded exploration and local verified KPI outcome memory
at most one V398-owned declarative canary is active and it applies to the next cycle only
material KPI regression or upstream hard hold rolls back only the exact V398-owned capability
failed V398 recipes are quarantined for bounded cycles and are not selected while quarantined
an active V397 experiment prevents a competing V398 experiment and retains the V397 lifecycle owner
source-level functionality remains non-executable and continues through verified canary evidence and protected PR/CI
market direction, facts, prices and grades are never invented
source code is never auto-generated or auto-rewritten and Git/main is never written by runtime autonomy
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V398 may synthesize and rank multiple allowlisted operational capability recipes, learn only from local verified KPI outcomes, run one owned next-cycle canary, reuse successful recipes, and quarantine or roll back failing recipes. It does not generate or rewrite source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass V397/V391/V390/V388 or earlier verification, infer market direction, promote unverified facts/prices/grades, import peer weights/raw state, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
